Hi Andrew Woods,

I just updated it and merged Joshua Allan Westgard's into the test section. Given that this is the last day of the sprint, I'm happy with where the doc is at. Joshua Allan Westgard, can you take a look at it and see what you think?

Bethany Seeger, I just read it over and think it looks great. Thanks for incorporating my edits. I think the headings make a huge difference in keeping it easy to digest. The plan is very thorough and well thought out, which will pay off in the coming sprints.

Unfortunately, I probably will not get to the "concrete tests" that I had proposed before out meeting at 3:30, but I should be able to run them in the coming days and can report the results on the wiki page.
